overview: Lidia Sobieska, the Polish prime minister, fights with traditional karate. Wavu Wiki highlights her punishment: she has a punisher for almost every frame window. Her best mix-ups are launch punishable on a wrong guess, and her stance transitions are a required part of her game.
playstyle: Precise punishment and stance flow. Punish everything with the right tool, keep pressure with plus moves (df+4~3, f,f,F+1, qcf+4) and flow between Horse (HRS), Cat (CAT) and Wolf (WLF) stances. Her mix-ups commit hard, so pick your moments. In Heat she gains Heaven and Earth (HAE).

stances.name: Horse
stances.note: HRS.1 is homing and +1 on block; HRS.2 is a Heat Engager; Wavu lists HRS follow-ups after a counter-hit f,F+2.

stances.name: Cat
stances.entry: 1,2,2 on hit or block, and others
stances.note: Wavu mini-combo: counter-hit df+2 into CAT.3.

stances.name: Wolf
stances.entry: qcf+1+2,2 on hit or block, HRS.1
stances.note: Another stance in her flow; check the Move Library for its moves.

keyMoves: Fast check; 1,2,2 and 1,4 are her i10 punishes (Wavu).
Coiled Elbow Slam: i15 mid, +0 on block.
A safe mid that can transition to stance.
Swift High Seikenzuki: i13 high from a run, +6 on block, tornadoes on hit.
To close distance and keep the turn.
Cleaving Spirit: i15 launcher, -5 on block.
Her i15 launch punisher, safe on block.
Gankaku: i15 punish string (Wavu: s-15), tornadoes on hit.
Upward Thrust: i15 while-standing tornado, -12 on block.
Bridging the Gap: i14 while-standing knee, -12 on block.
Flash Elbow: i12 Heat Engager from crouch, -14 on block.
A fast crouch punish that starts Heat.
Back Spin Kick: i16 homing high, -3 on block, launches on counter hit (+31a).
Lame Duck: i18 low, -14 on block.
Adjourning Sweep: i16 homing low, -11 on block, can transition to stance.
Stalwart Governance: i18 mid Heat Engager, +2 on block.
To start Heat and keep the turn.

combos.name: CH f,F+2 → HRS.2
combos.situation: Your f,F+2 lands as a counter hit (Wavu mini-combo).
mistakes: Following up after a normal hit outside Heat: it needs the counter hit.
